en.title: ``Hair removal salon simulator'' that burns away bristles with a laser is released today on Steam. There are also elements that were not in the trial version, such as ``design hair transplant'' that plants hair on customers.
en.summary: 2PGames today released the PC game ``Hair Removal Salon Simulator'' developed by Yoshio Games on Steam. This is a simulation game in which the player runs a hair removal salon that specializes in men with a high sense of beauty. In the product version, ``design hair transplantation'', which was not available in the trial version, has been added. You can use a hair transplant gun to implant hair in the design of your choice onto the bodies of super VIPs who visit your store.

items.title: BioWare联合创始人：拯救《质量效应5》需要2亿美元成本
items.summary: BioWare联合创始人特伦特·奥斯特表示，制作一款新的《质量效应5》游戏成本将超过2亿美元。他认为，玩家期待获得顶级的3A级开发品质，而这需要极高的前期资金投入。 特伦特·奥斯特的表态源于近期发起的“拯救质量效应”网络请愿活动。请愿者呼吁EA继续资助《质量效应》系列，或者将版权出售、授权给其他工作室。目前该活动在 Change.org 上已收集到超过30万个签名。 EA此前关闭了RPG工作室 BioWare ，导致《质量效应5》取消开发。《龙腾世纪》前制作人马克·达拉等开发者同样建议EA出售版权，让项目在其他团队手中延续。然而业界认为，有能力买下版权并承担数亿美元开发预算的工作室屈指可数。

ja.title: BioWare 共同創設者: Mass Effect 5 の保存には 2 億ドルかかる
ja.summary: BioWare の共同創設者であるトレント・オースター氏は、マスエフェクト 5 の新作を作るには 2 億ドル以上かかると述べました。同氏は、プレイヤーは一流の AAA 開発品質を期待しており、そのためには非常に高額な先行投資が必要になると考えています。トレント・オースターの声明は、最近の「マスエフェクトを救え」オンライン請願の結果として出された。請願者らはEAに対し、マスエフェクトシリーズへの資金提供を継続するか、他のスタジオに権利を販売しライセンス供与するよう求めた。このキャンペーンはこれまでにChange.orgで30万以上の署名を集めている。 EAは以前、RPGスタジオBioWareを閉鎖し、『Mass Effect 5』の開発を中止させた。 「ドラゴンエイジ」の元プロデューサーであるマーク・ダラー氏などの開発者も、EAが権利を売却し、プロジェクトを他のチームの手に委ねることを提案した。しかし、業界では、権利を購入し、数億ドルの開発予算を負担できるスタジオはほんの一握りであると考えられています。

en.title: BioWare co-founder: Saving Mass Effect 5 will cost $200 million
en.summary: BioWare co-founder Trent Auster said it would cost more than $200 million to make a new Mass Effect 5 game. He believes that players expect top-notch AAA development quality, which requires extremely high upfront capital investment. Trent Auster's statement comes as a result of the recent "Save Mass Effect" online petition. The petitioners called on EA to continue funding the Mass Effect series, or to sell and license the rights to other studios. The campaign has so far collected more than 300,000 signatures on Change.org. EA previously closed RPG studio BioWare, causing the development of "Mass Effect 5" to be canceled. Developers such as Mark Darrah, the former producer of "Dragon Age", also suggested that EA sell the rights and let the project continue in the hands of other teams. However, the industry believes that there are only a handful of studios that can afford to buy the rights and shoulder a development budget of hundreds of millions of dollars.

The player will play a Red Army lieutenant, leading the troops to fight and retreat from the desperate situation near Kaluga, surviving the most difficult moments until the city is liberated. 15 missions are staggered on the campaign map. It is up to the player to decide where to fight next, which route to take, and whether to take risks to complete additional objectives. Every battle, every choice, every return to the battlefield will affect the subsequent battle situation and lead the story to different endings. Players will command infantry, tanks, artillery and support units in the game and engage in intense multi-arms coordinated operations. en.summary: The PS5 version of "GTA6" is now available for pre-loading on the PSN mall in the Asia-Pacific region, while the Xbox version will be available at 8:00 Beijing time on November 10th. ja.summary: Xboxの最高執行責任者ヘレン・チャン氏が就任わずか3カ月で退任する中、29年間マイクロソフトのベテラン幹部シャノン・ロフティス氏は社内の現状を「道化の茶番劇」と呼び、現在の経営陣を公に批判した。彼女は以前、会社の方針に違反したために解雇されたという主張は不正確であり、彼女の沈黙が承認されたと誤解されるべきではないと公に述べた。シャノン・ロフティス氏は、機密情報をメディアに漏洩したことはなく、他の企業に転職したこともなく、差別、いじめ、嫌がらせ、詐欺などの行為にも関与していないと強調した。彼女はまた、積極的に高い地位を求めてはいないとも述べた。彼女は、過去の業績と会社の取り決めに基づいて、今年 7 月に最高執行責任者に昇進しました。同時に、ロフティス氏は同社の評価基準の実践について深刻な懸念を表明し、自身を含む従業員が受けた不正義は真剣に受け止められるべきだと考えた。ロフティスは、内部情報源から外部に漏洩したと思われる虚偽の情報は遺憾であり、Xboxのリーダーシップを示すものであると考えている。

en.title: Former Xbox senior executive blasts current leadership, calling status quo a 'clown farce'
en.summary: With Xbox chief operating officer Helen Zhang leaving after just three months on the job, 29-year veteran Microsoft executive Shannon Loftis publicly criticized the current leadership, calling the current situation within the company a "clown farce." She previously publicly stated that claims she was fired for violating company policy were inaccurate and that her silence should not be mistaken for approval. Shannon Loftis stressed that she had not leaked confidential information to the media, had not moved to other companies, nor had she been involved in any behavior such as discrimination, bullying, harassment or fraud. She also mentioned that she did not actively seek a higher position. She was promoted to chief operating officer in July this year based on past performance and company arrangements. At the same time, Loftis expressed serious concerns about the company's practice of assessment standards and believed that the injustice suffered by employees, including himself, should be taken seriously. Loftis believes that the false information that appears to be leaked from internal sources to the outside world is regrettable and shows the leadership of Xbox.
